items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I remember we had a fellow in that band, Louie Jones.

ctx.x: And well we stayed over there and went all over Europe playing. We'd go to the officer's mess and we'd play and you'd get money and Vodrey used to take the money and go to Paris so one day the Lieutenant says we're going to Leone now which way shall we go. Shall we go through Paris or go the other way. We said, let's go to Paris, so he took us into Paris and when I got outside of Paris, I said so this is Paris bring on the women.

And we went into a place they had there, half of the place was for dancing and the other was for rollerskating and we played in the dance section and I remember we had a fellow in that band, Louie Jones. He was a great violin player from New York and he was from Boston, but he was a very great violinist.
Can you name any other guys that were in that band around that time. Remember any of the fellows' names.
